name: Assystem S.A.
summary: Assystem S.A. provides engineering and infrastructure project management services worldwide. It operates in two segments, Energy & Infrastructure, and Staffing. The company develops, executes, delivers, and manages critical and complex infrastructure projects for public authorities, utility companies, and equipment manufacturers; and offers engineering procurement and construction management, project management consulting, industrial control system, siting and permitting, compliance, safety and security, digital and data, and systems integration services for nuclear, energy, healthcare and life sciences, transportation, defense, and buildings and infrastructure sectors. It also provides specialist consultants and technicians for the oil and gas, defense, telecommunications, public transport, equipment, mining, metallurgy, and nuclear industries. The company was formerly known as AssystemBrime S.A. and changed its name to Assystem S.A. in June 2005. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Courbevoie, France. Assystem S.A. is a subsidiary of HDL Development.
